title: Engineering Release Watch
notes: Keep the local watch database aligned to the tracked-source registry.
Preserve prior read history that already exists in the watch database.
Write only articles that are unread before delivery for this run.
After a successful delivery, mark the delivered unread articles as read in the same watch database.
Apply the per-source delivery cap to the unread backlog for each run and leave the remaining unread backlog available for later reruns.
Do not bulk-mark unread backlog items as read before their delivery turn.
Resolved feed references and bundled mirror source files should stay bundle-relative and keep their data/ prefix.
The source_files audit list should cover the seed state, the registry, the contract, and only the mirror files used to resolve feeds for this run.
If any legacy blogs are removed during reconciliation, call them out in Source Coverage.
